findings.title: zip of error_ids with get_multi values misaligns IDs and data
findings.body: nodestore get_multi returns a dict keyed by node_id; zipping error_ids against events.values() assumes ordering and completeness. If ids are deduplicated or missing, events get attributed to the wrong error id. Iterate node_ids and look up events[node_id] instead.

findings.title: request.user.id may fail for org auth tokens / anonymous users
findings.body: This endpoint accepts org auth tokens (is_org_auth_token_auth), where request.user is AnonymousUser with id None. Analytics are also recorded before the feature check, so events are emitted even for orgs without the feature.

findings.title: TableWidgetVisualization rendered with empty columns and data
findings.body: When the use-table-widget-visualization flag is on, the widget is passed hardcoded empty columns/tableData instead of the query results, so flagged orgs see empty tables.

findings.title: Logging whole WorkflowEventData object in extra
findings.body: workflow_event_data contains the GroupEvent; putting the dataclass into log extra may be non-serializable/huge.

findings.title: Hidden attributes only filtered when searching
findings.body: HIDDEN_ATTRIBUTES is applied only in the search branch; with an empty query the sorted list is returned unfiltered, so hidden attributes still show by default.

findings.title: PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title referenced but defined on CommitContextIntegration
findings.body: _truncate_title is added to CommitContextIntegration, yet get_merged_pr_single_issue_template calls PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title, which will raise AttributeError unless PRCommentWorkflow defines it.
